rules.text: Master numbers bring powerful positives and negatives; difficulty and great strength

source.quote: a Master Number can mean difficulty but also great strength

rules.say: Master numbers bring powerful positives and negatives; they can mean difficulty but also great strength.

rules.text: "Master of Intuitiveness": spiritual, interest in occult; analytical, logical; independent; courageous; moral, old-school; natural leader; support system for others

source.quote: The natives of this number turn out to be quite spiritually inclined

rules.say: Master 11 is the master of intuition: you are spiritual with an interest in the occult, yet analytical and logical. Independent, courageous and moral, you are a natural leader and a support for others.

rules.text: Sensitive, empathetic, trusting (trust gets them hurt); loyal, romantic partner; strong sexual desire; won't compromise until perfect match

source.quote: Their trusting nature is what gets the natives hurt the most.

rules.say: You are sensitive, empathetic and trusting, and that trust can get you hurt. A loyal, romantic partner, you will not compromise until you find the perfect match.

rules.text: Strong intuition; "dreamers but not doers"; should follow gut; overthinker, anxiety, stress, frequent anxiety attacks

source.quote: They are dreamers but not doers

rules.say: You have strong intuition and should follow your gut, but you can be a dreamer rather than a doer. Take care of overthinking, which can bring stress and frequent anxiety attacks.

rules.text: "Master Builder": generous, self-improving, builds for self and others; "dreamer and a Doer"; confident, responsible

source.quote: we can say they are the dreamer and a Doers

rules.say: Master 22 is the master builder: generous and always improving, you build for yourself and others. You are both a dreamer and a doer, confident and responsible.

rules.text: Creative; creative career: "success is guaranteed" (guaranteed promise - SKIP the guarantee wording)

source.quote: it is suggested that the natives take this up as a career as success is guaranteed

rules.text: Intelligent, perfectionist; seeks balanced life, achieved later; considered very lucky, others jealous; optimistic, hard-working, finishes tasks

source.quote: The natives also are considered very lucky.

rules.say: You are intelligent, a perfectionist, optimistic and hard-working, and you finish what you start. You are considered very lucky, which can make others jealous, and a balanced life tends to come later.

rules.text: Negative: aggression, poor anger control, impulsiveness

source.quote: They will have little to no control over their anger

rules.say: Take care of aggression and impulsiveness, and of your anger, which can be hard for you to control.

rules.text: "Master of Spirituality"/"Master Preachers": nurturing, kind, compassionate, helps all; learned, shares knowledge; optimistic; human magnet; hidden creative genius; humanitarian, trusts easily, gets hurt

source.quote: Master number 33 is also associated with the term Master Preachers.

rules.say: Master 33 is the master of spirituality: nurturing, kind and compassionate, you help everyone and share your knowledge. A human magnet with hidden creative genius, you trust easily and can get hurt.

rules.text: Negative: silently judgemental; superiority complex; panic and anxiety attacks from over-attachment

source.quote: might even suffer from the well-known 'Superiority Complex.'

rules.say: Take care not to judge others silently or feel superior. Over-attachment can bring panic and anxiety attacks.
